title: Bird dog

steps.text: Start on your hands and knees with your wrists under your shoulders.
steps.cue: Hands and knees, wrists under shoulders.

steps.text: Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with your back.
steps.cue: Reach one arm forward, the opposite leg back.

steps.text: Keep your hips level and your belly firm for one breath.
steps.cue: Hips level, belly firm, one breath.

steps.text: Return to the start and switch sides.

mistakes: Letting your hips tip to one side.
Lifting your head to look forward instead of down.
regression: Move only the arm, or only the leg, and keep the toes on the floor.
stopIf: Stop if you feel pain in your lower back or wrists.

anatomy.why: The muscles around the trunk hold the spine still while one arm and one leg reach away.
